mapper.select: SELECT r.route_no, r.total_slots, COUNT(v.vehicle_no) AS assigned_count FROM hd_route r LEFT JOIN hd_vehicle v ON v.route_no = r.route_no GROUP BY r.route_no, r.total_slots ORDER BY r.route_no
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hd_route WHERE route_no = #{routeNo})
SELECT route_no FROM hd_route WHERE route_no = #{routeNo} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE hd_route SET total_slots = #{totalSlots}, updated_at = now() WHERE route_no = #{routeNo}
